name: Employee attrition
description: Check in with people who may be thinking of leaving.
label: Attrition
source_note: IBM HR Analytics sample (fictional employees). Download the CSV and upload it here.
metric_line: Leavers reached by a check-in in your top 10%
intake_goal: We want to know which employees may be thinking of leaving so managers can check in with them first.
replies: We want to know which employees may be thinking of leaving so managers can check in with them first.
Managers can hold about 10% of check-ins each month.
Replacing someone costs about 20,000 dollars, a check-in costs about 50 dollars of time. About 1,500 employees.
